nonblocking_source_notes.finding: The primary article has two main XML tables; the rework request for xml:table=3 is stale relative to the local source. Supplementary Table S3 is present as DOCX and was parsed.

TIF figure assets were opened through the OA package inventory and captions. Exact plot digitization was not used for final numeric rows; structured XML/XLS/DOCX sources supplied the table-level values needed for worker-2 repair.
